title: OpenAI expands partnership with Oracle to bring its apps to ChatGPT
summary: OpenAI and Oracle are expanding their partnership to bring business applications and AI agents into ChatGPT and power new Oracle offerings.
investorNote: 企业 Agent 的竞争焦点正在转向现有业务系统的授权、采购与治理入口。

fact.subject: OpenAI 与 Oracle
fact.object: Oracle 应用与数据接入 ChatGPT 及新产品

evidence.quote: OpenAI and Oracle are bringing Oracle applications and data into ChatGPT and powering new Oracle products and services with OpenAI models and products.
Oracle is developing Oracle AI Workspace
Oracle customers in the U.S. can purchase access to the OpenAI API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work through Oracle Marketplace

displayTitle: OpenAI 与 Oracle 扩大合作，企业应用拟接入 ChatGPT
narrative: OpenAI 与 Oracle 宣布扩展合作：Oracle 正开发 AI Workspace，计划让用户在 ChatGPT 中读取获准的企业应用数据并完成工作流；Oracle 也公布安全、SMB 套餐和应用构建产品。美国客户可经 Oracle Marketplace 采购 OpenAI 服务。这里的关键是企业身份、权限和采购渠道被接进 Agent 入口，但 Workspace 仍处开发阶段，不能写成全面上线。

eventRelation.reason: 当天合作公告新增 Oracle 应用集成及多个产品计划，已有的两家公司云合作只是背景。
